साउथ और बॉलीवुड सिनेमा प्रेमियों के लिए एक बहुत बड़ी खबर सामने आई है! 🎬

बहुप्रतीक्षित फिल्म O.M का जबरदस्त trailer रिलीज कर दिया गया है, जिसने आते ही सोशल मीडिया पर तहलका मचा दिया है। 🔥

इस फिल्म में Dhanush लाल चंदन के खतरनाक माफिया के खिलाफ Operation Mole चलाते हुए बेहद intense और एक्शन पैक्ड अवतार में नजर आ रहे हैं।

trailer में Dhanush के धमाकेदार अंदाज के साथ-साथ Mammootty और Sai Pallavi ने अपनी शानदार परफॉर्मेंस से पूरी महफिल ही लूट ली है। 💥

नेटिजन्स सोशल मीडिया पर X reactions के जरिए फिल्म के इस एक्शन ड्रामा और स्टार कास्ट की अदाकारी की जमकर सराहना कर रहे हैं।

क्या आप Dhanush, Mammootty और Sai Pallavi की इस एक्शन फिल्म O.M को देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? अपनी राय कमेंट्स में जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: O.M Trailer Out: Dhanush's Operation Mole against red sandalwood mafia looks intense, Mammootty & Sai Pallavi steal show
ctx.summary:
After much delay, the much-awaited trailer for Dhanush's O.M i.e., OPERATION MOLE Chapter 1: Udhiram - The Blood Wood, is finally out, and it lives up to the hype. The trailer introduces us to the world of red sandalwood smuggling. Dhanush plays a woodcutter who gets pulled deep into the dangerous syndicate. O.M i.e., OPERATION MOLE 
 Sai Pallavi, who is currently winning hearts as Sita Mata in  Ramayana , makes a powerful impact as Nithya Reddy, a CBI officer in O.M. Her character glimpse earlier described her as a mix of "honesty, smartness, and experience in young blood," and the trailer shows her leading Operation Mole to bust the smuggling ring. The biggest surprise is Mammootty, who seems to be playing a politician. In his first on-screen collaboration with Dhanush, he appears in a grey-shaded, commanding avatar who seems to control the trade from the shadows. 
 The trailer also gives a glimpse of Naseeruddin Shah. Though his character details remain under wraps, it seems to be a short role. Besides the four acting giants, Sreeleela also stars in the film. She is playing Dhanush's wife. Her look is very realistic and natural.  
 The film is written and directed by Rajkumar Periasamy of Amaran fame, with music by Sai Abhyankar. Produced by Wunderbar Films and RTake Studios, the film is mounted as a franchise opener. With slick action, strong performances, and a gripping story, O.M looks like a promising bet from Tamil Cinema this year.
